description: This file defines a Next.js page component 'RepositoriesPage' that displays a list of repositories along with analytics data. It manages state related to organizational ID, fetches analytics metrics, and renders repository info, metrics, and recent activity feeds. It also handles user interactions for setting the organization ID.

methods.name: RepositoriesPage
methods.description: Main React component rendering the repositories analytics dashboard, managing state, data fetching, and UI rendering.
